title: Intrusive Thought cue: trigger live Recall, Intermediator reconsolidation, and Character Thought to mint present-day realizations

sections.what: Add an **Intrusive Thought** trigger in the Mind panel and Memory Weaver so the author can inject an internal mental cue (either standalone or immediately after planting a new backstory memory via `task-986`) and run the character's live cognitive loop: time-locked **Recall** (`engine/memory_retrieval.py`) -> **Intermediator reconsolidation** (`_synthesizeConsciousThought` in `static/js/agent/prompt-builder/memory-context.ts`) -> **Character Thought** reaction, with an option to commit the resulting present-day `Thought` (`belief` / realization) at `current_tick`.
sections.why: Planting a backstory memory quietly into `Player.memories[]` leaves it dormant until a future turn happens to hit matching cues, and Memory Weaver's drafting call (`g.no_broadcast = True`) bypasses Recall and Intermediator entirely. Authors need a way to drop an internal spark into a character's mind and watch them actually remember, reconsolidate, and react to it right now without corrupting historical timestamps.
sections.how:
1. Add an `Intrusive Thought` action in the Mind panel (and an optional post-save toggle `Trigger intrusive thought now` in Memory Weaver).
2. Feed the cue (and any newly minted memory IDs from `task-986`) into `engine/memory_retrieval.py` (strictly time-locked to `world_datetime <= current_world_datetime`) to gather matching `observation`, `event`, and `thought` traces.
3. Run `_synthesizeConsciousThought` (Intermediator) with the character's current mood, `interests`, `fears`, and `disinterests`, followed by a concise in-character inner-monologue `Thought` generation.
4. Render the 3-step trace in the UI (Recalled memories -> Intermediator synthesis -> Present-day Thought) and provide a one-click commit that saves the present-day `Thought` at `current_tick` linked via `source_memory_ids` (and `contradicts[]` / `relationship_deltas` if an older belief shifted).
sections.verify: Run `npm run build:ts` and `pytest` on time-locked retrieval + lineage tests, and verify live in the browser Mind panel that injecting an intrusive thought after planting an age-12 memory produces a present-day Thought stamped at `current_tick` while keeping the original event stamped at age 12.

acceptance.text: Author can inject an intrusive thought cue from the Mind panel or right after saving a Memory Weaver bundle.
The cue runs real time-locked Recall (`world_datetime <= T`) -> Intermediator reconsolidation -> in-character Thought and displays all three stages in the UI.

Committing the resulting realization saves a `type: thought` memory stamped at `current_tick` with `source_memory_ids` (and `contradicts[]` when applicable), never overwriting the historical `world_datetime` of past events.

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: Character Inspector -> Mind Dashboard (`static/js/inspector/mind-view.ts`) and Memory Weaver post-save flow (`static/js/inspector/memory-view.ts`) on http://localhost:4444/.

Manual verification steps:
1. Plant a past memory (e.g. age-12 skateboard/Kyrie event) with "Trigger intrusive thought now" checked, or enter an intrusive thought directly in Mind.
2. Inspect the staged output.
   - expected: Shows Recalled traces, Intermediator synthesis, and present-day Thought; committing saves the Thought at `current_tick` linked to the age-12 memories.
